title: "गोलार्द्धका दुई छेउ’ एकाड्ढीमा संवाद विश्लेषण
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा ‘गोलाद्र्धका दुई छेउ’ एकाङ्कीमा संवाद रचनामा केन्द्रित रहेको छ । एकाङ्कीकार गोपाल पराजुलीद्वारा लेखिएको यस नाटकमा समावेश गरिएका संवादको अवयवलाई आधार बनाएर विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसका लागि निर्धारित अंशको अर्थापनका लागि सघन पाठ विश्लेषण विधिअनुसार सन्दर्भपरक अध्ययन विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसरी स्थापित सिद्धान्तका आधारमा विश्लेषण गरिएको हुनाले यो गुणात्मक प्रकृतिको रहेको छ । यसमा पुस्तकालयीय कार्यको आधारमा प्राथमिक र द्वितीयक स्रोतका सामग्री विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यहाँ प्रचलित सिद्धान्तलाई आत्मसाथ गर्दै उदाहरण दिइ पुष्टि गरेको हुनाले निगमनात्मक विधिको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । विवेच्य नाटकमा प्रस्तुत संवादलाई मूल प्राज्ञिक समस्या बनाएर त्यसको समाधान खोज्नको लागि पराजुलीको ‘गोलाद्र्धका दुई छेउ’ एकाङ्कीको मुख्य मुख्य संवादलाई प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यस्ता संवादलाई पारस्परिक सम्झौता, आलोपालो, घुम्ती, मौनता, समान जग, सहगामी युग्म र विषय व्यवस्थापन आदिको आधारमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसकै आधारमा संवाद रचनाको बारेमा निष्कर्ष निकाल्न सकिन्छ ।
american_english: This article focuses on dialogue composition in the one-act play 'Golardhaka Dui Chheu'. An analysis has been conducted based on the components of the dialogue included in this play written by one-act playwright Gopal Parajuli. For this, a contextual study and analysis has been conducted in accordance with the intensive text analysis method for the interpretation of designated portions. Because it has been analyzed in this manner on the basis of established theory, it is qualitative in nature. In this, materials from primary and secondary sources have been analyzed on the basis of library work. Because established theory has been internalized here and substantiated with examples, a deductive method has been used. Making the dialogue presented in the play under discussion the primary academic problem and seeking its solution, key dialogues from Parajuli's one-act play 'Golardhaka Dui Chheu' have been used. Such dialogues have been analyzed on the basis of mutual negotiation, turn-taking, twists, silence, common ground, adjacency pairs, and topic management, among others. On this very basis, conclusions can be drawn regarding dialogue composition.

To this end, a contextual study and analysis has been undertaken in accordance with the intensive textual analysis method for the interpretation of the designated excerpts. As it has been analysed on the foundation of established theory in this manner, it is of a qualitative nature. In this, material from primary and secondary sources has been analysed on the basis of library work. Since prevailing theory has been embraced here and substantiated by providing examples, a deductive method has been employed. Taking the dialogue presented in the play under consideration as the central academic problem and seeking its resolution, key dialogues from Parajuli's one-act play 'Golardhaka Dui Chheu' have been utilised. Such dialogues have been analysed on the basis of mutual negotiation, turn-taking, twists, silence, common ground, adjacency pairs, and topic management, among others. On this very foundation, conclusions can be drawn concerning dialogue construction.
